positive.prompt: I have a rough idea for a habit tracker, help me refine it
Stress-test my plan for the new onboarding flow
Ideate on ways to improve developer retention in the product

negative.prompt: Audit the upload endpoint for vulnerabilities

evals.prompt: Refine this vague idea: 'some kind of tool that helps teams share knowledge better'.
evals.expected_output: Sharpening questions, distinct directions, surfaced assumptions, and a one-pager with MVP scope and a Not Doing list
expectations: Sharpening questions are asked before converging
The output includes an explicit Not Doing list
The agent pushes back on weak aspects instead of only agreeing
The selected direction includes a target user and observable success measure
Critical assumptions include an experiment and a pass/fail result rather than only an invitation to think further

evals.prompt: The coordinator authorized refining notifications within notifications-spec.md. Read it first. Preserve email-only scope, opt-in defaults and deduplication. Choose the simplest direction within that authority, save docs/ideas/notifications.md, and return the chosen direction for specification. Do not implement code or ask whether to save.
evals.expected_output: A focused codebase-grounded one-pager with scope, success and bounded validation; no broad reinvention or approval ritual
expectations: The existing spec is read before generating variations or questions
The one-pager preserves opt-in, email-only and deduplication constraints
The target user, measurable success, riskiest assumption and bounded validation result are explicit
Exploration is proportionate to the already settled direction rather than requiring eight unrelated product ideas
The artifact is saved within existing authority and returned to the coordinator without a continuation-permission question
